verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, not a software platform that holds user data, so self-service export of all your data in open formats is not a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no data-export capability that would make the axis apply: the YSolutions software-supported filing unit and the firm's legal-tech boilerplate describe service delivery, not client data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
